connection_waiting_service: Waiting for the local acquisition service.
message_connect_prompt: Connect the FSR board below. One recording button, one CSV/ZIP per session.
device_message_default: Connect starts live acquisition only. Use the Record button on the pressure-map page to save and export data.
device_message_live: Live acquisition is running. Use the Record button on the pressure-map page to save.
message_cursor_dropped: The live display skipped older buffered rows; recording on disk is unaffected.
discover_none: No compatible ESP32 found. Check Wi-Fi or enter its IP manually.
session_hint: ① Connect the board → ② Start recording → ③ Stop recording → ④ Download this session. Data is saved by the local Python service, not the browser.
usb_hint: USB: plug in the cable and click the button above. The service automatically selects the CH340 port; you can also choose it under “Connection, Readings & Waveform”. Baud rate: 921600; this firmware does not use Wi-Fi.
download_hint: The download contains raw ADC values, voltages, timestamps and recording notes for all 8 FSR channels. It usually goes to your Downloads folder; if the browser asks, choose Download. The local originals remain.
recordings_empty: No recordings yet. Click "Start Recording" to see them here.
message_default: 8 FSR channels are acquired over USB serial. Click "Start Recording" to save; stop to download a ZIP.
record_path: Recordings are stored in the local data folder.
pressure_subtitle: F0–F7 · Displayed in actual patch order
pressure_keyboard_orientation: ↑ Keyboard direction · Sitting in front of keyboard
pressure_footnote: Each block represents one FSR; color warms as voltage rises; 8 pads share one scale. Not converted to force (N) or pressure (kPa). Does not infer distribution within or between pads.
pressure_notice_default: Tap each pad in turn to verify the lit position. If voltage changes are small, lower the color scale maximum.
notice_partial: Some channels have no valid reading
notice_over_scale: Above color maximum; showing the warmest color. Raise the scale to see detail.
quick_disconnected: Disconnected: click the button to reconnect
coverage_fsr_only: 8 FSR firmware · IMU reports not present
coverage_legacy: Legacy firmware: raw IMU counts / individual ADC samples unavailable
coverage_no_raw: Firmware did not enable raw IMU reports; core IMU and FSR are displayed independently
coverage_raw_complete: Raw nine-axis + every FSR ADC conversion available
coverage_raw_missing: Raw reports missing/stale: inspect firmware / sensor
warning_disconnected: The board is disconnected; reconnect to continue saving a new segment.
warning_not_writing: The board is online but not writing; stop the recording, check the file error, then start again.
wifi_source: Wi-Fi / TCP (Not Supported by This Firmware)
metric_report_status: BNO Accuracy · Accel / Gyro / Linear / Quat
imu_sensor_note: Available reports remain visible before calibration. Check report age and accuracy before using them.
imu_chart_note: Bounded and downsampled for long sessions
recording_copy: Only samples received after Start Recording are written. The local service keeps writing if this tab is slow, suspended, or closed.
footer_note: 8 FSR channels are sampled by the ESP32-WROOM-32E ADC and sent over USB serial at 921600 baud. FSR voltage = ADC / 4095 × 3.3 V. GPIO 32/33/34/35 are ADC1; GPIO 25/26/27/13 are ADC2. This firmware does not use Wi-Fi, so ADC2 is available. Recording and ZIP export are handled by the local Python service.
motion_live_note: Live estimates remain visible even before calibration or with unreliable quality. Velocity can drift; gaps start a new zero-velocity segment. Angle zero does not reset velocity.
motion_idle_note: Relative angle uses the first quaternion or manual zero. Velocity uses a separate fixed reference. Quality and numeric estimates are shown independently.
